$comment: Every docs page that moved, old URL -> new URL, English paths only. The single source for the redirects in docs/vercel.json: run `node scripts/docs-redirects.mjs --write` after editing, and scripts/__tests__/docsMoves.test.mjs fails until you do. Each `pages` entry also redirects /ko/<old> and <old>.md. Entries are permanent: a later move rewrites the destination here instead of adding a second hop. `aliases` are URLs that were never pages (no .md copy) and are mirrored under /ko only.
